title: IDE chat process does not inherit relay secret from integrated terminal
description: Claude Code relay wait returned RELAY_AUTH_REQUIRED although the same AHP_RELAY_SECRET had been exported in the IDE terminal. The chat command process required explicit credential injection. Adapters need a host secret-manager or documented process-level provisioning path without placing real secrets in chat.
close_reason: Added --secret-file and AHP_RELAY_SECRET_FILE with minimum length, regular-file, non-symlink, size, and POSIX permission checks; verified by EVD-20260901-E7177047.
